en-US.description: Detects which tools you use and runs the appropriate commands to update them.
en-US.longDescription: Keeping your system up to date usually involves invoking multiple package managers. This results in big, non-portable shell one-liners saved in your shell. To remedy this, Topgrade detects which tools you use and runs the appropriate commands to update them.
en-US.name: topgrade
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- (linux) add Omarchy support (#2494)
- (microsoft_store) add support for the store CLI (#2497)
- (pre_sudo) run pre_sudo before self-update (#2492)
- (tailscale) pass --yes when assume_yes is set (#2489)
Fixed
- (sdkman) source the init script instead of relying on .bashrc (#2482)
- (tailscale) don't update when installed via homebrew (#2504)
- (tailscale) gate Tailscale step to Windows and macOS (#2500)
- (waydroid) skip when Waydroid is not initialized (#2484)
- (claude-code) don't fail with EOF on long output (#2062)
